content:
The **Crushing Blow** is an explosive heavy gun in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

The weapon was available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge "Kill Legendary Enemies (0/25)" in Survival mode from March 26 to April 1, 2019. The weapon was then made available again from September 24 to October 1, 2019.
